meta.title: Ways to help
meta.description: Other ways to help Happy Paws Cat Rescue: foster a cat, fundraise, give from our wish list or volunteer.

s1.p: Adoption isn’t the only way you can support our rescue.
s1.p2: If you would like to help us but are not in a position to adopt, here are some alternatives.
s1.alt: A black-and-white tuxedo cat sitting on a wooden floor, looking up

s2.p: It costs, on average, £200 to rehome a cat. Donations help us to keep helping the cats that need us. Give once, or every month.
s2.p2: Fostering is the vital stepping stone in our work. It gives our cats the chance to feel safe during what can be a very stressful time for them.
s2.p3: As a registered charity we rely on fundraising and donations. If you fancy holding a fundraising event for us, we would be overjoyed. A cake sale, car boot sale, quiz night or coffee morning would all be wonderful.
s2.p4: We are always in need of supplies, so we have set up a Wish List on Amazon. It is an easy way for our supporters to donate the products we really need.

s3.h2: ==£200 is ==what it costs us, on average, to rehome one cat
s3.p: If a cat needs medical attention, it can cost considerably more. Whatever you can give goes straight to the cats in our care.
